issue.body:
Issue opened also in the FastAPI discussions [here](https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/11153#discussion-6225371).

### Example Code

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(root_path="/wms")


@app.get("/hello")
async def root():
    return {"message": "Hello World"}
```

The program runs in gunicorn (using the uvicorn worker class) behind a nginx proxy which strips away the root_path (as described in [Behind a proxy](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/behind-a-proxy/#setting-the-root_path-in-the-fastapi-app)).

Before fastapi 0.109 (and before starlette 0.35.0) an URL with a trailing slash (ex. https://127.0.0.1/wms/hello/) would be redirected to the corresponding URL without the trailing slash (ex. https://127.0.0.1/wms/hello) as expected.

From fastapi 0.109 (and from starlette 0.35.0) the redirect no more includes the root_path, so from https://127.0.0.1/wms/hello/ the application redirects to https://127.0.0.1/hello which results in a 404 Not Found error.

Here the headers of the redirect request:
![image](https://github.com/encode/starlette/assets/1143780/27344c7d-e875-43ea-9d1b-e1d59cfaa5ed)

I think the issue came from [this change](https://github.com/encode/starlette/commit/c3c6314759b8356df185857c6001de6c8575708d#diff-e939ae940ce35a0db1544bfea4ab853be43ba89ea33e3cac713aa0b19f4bb875) which strips away the root_path from the path in the URL constructor which seems to me off, even considering the ASGI specs.

_Originally posted by @Mattiam2 in https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/discussions/2514_
issue.title: Root path is not preserved when starlette application is mounted at a custom path
